title: Simple Chat Room
description: Build a multi-room chat system where clients can join a room and messages are broadcast to that room only.
problemStatement:
# Multi-Room Chat

Create a WebSocket endpoint `/ws/{room}` that implements a chat room:
- Each room is identified by the path parameter.
- Clients can join any room.
- Messages sent by a client are broadcast to all other clients in the same room.
- When a client connects, send a welcome message: `{"system": "You joined room {room}"}`.
- When a client disconnects, notify other clients in the room: `{"system": "User left"}`.
- Use a dictionary to store active connections per room.

**Bonus:** Add a username field (e.g., from query parameter) and include it in messages.
hints:
Store `rooms: dict[str, list[WebSocket]]`.
On connect, add to the room list.
On message, iterate over the room's connections (excluding sender) and send.
Handle disconnection by removing from the list.
expectedOutput: Clients in different rooms do not see each other's messages. Joins/leaves are announced.
